listing.name: Gamma UI Draw
listing.summary: Do you remember Gamma war? Do you remember those silly bol i usually post every where? Now we have an UI which have the same art style!
listing.aiSummary: Reskins the vanilla user interface with a hand-painted art style inspired by Gamma war.

description: Replaces standard UI elements with custom artwork matching a specific fan-art aesthetic. Includes modified cursors, menus, and other interface components that require manual file replacement in the game directory to function fully.
